title: The Nest of Knives
text: A bird's nest woven of knives, blades and broken swords is wedged in a dead tree. In it sit three dull, heavy eggs of iron. Somewhere above, something beats its wings, slow and huge, every feather sounding like steel.

options.label: The quickest climbs for an iron egg while the wings beat somewhere above.

outcomes.text: The egg is warm, heavy and worth a fortune. Above, the wingbeats stop.
The bird is not somewhere above. It is here.

options.label: Pull blades from the bottom of the nest, where the bird will not miss them.

outcomes.text: The blades are all fine work. One still holds a hand's warmth in the grip.

options.label: Leave the tree alone; nothing that builds with knives should be crossed.

outcomes.text: Something with iron feathers watches you go. It drops one point-down in the earth beside you, good iron and a warning both.
